data.name: Cluster Burst VR
data.detailed_description:
Cluster Burst VR is a fast, reactive VR shooter where cube clusters rush toward you from multiple lanes. Your goal is simple: destroy them before they reach you.

Instead of clearing a static structure, threats approach from three directions: left, center, and right. Each cluster is made up of smaller cubes that must be broken apart piece by piece. As they move closer, their speed increases, creating constant pressure. Every successful hit briefly slows a cluster down, giving you a short window to react before it accelerates again.

You begin by facing a single cluster, allowing you to learn the mechanics and build accuracy. As you progress, multiple lanes activate at the same time. When several clusters advance together, you must decide whether to finish a weakened target or switch focus to a more immediate threat.

Different cube types require matching shot colors. Switching between colors introduces a short delay, so timing matters just as much as precision. Choosing the right moment to swap can make the difference between control and being overwhelmed.

The gameplay rewards focus, accuracy, and quick decision making. Well placed shots buy you time, while hesitation can quickly lead to failure. With increasing speed and overlapping threats, each run becomes a test of skill and control.

Cluster Burst VR is designed for replayability, encouraging players to improve their performance and push for higher scores with every run.

VR Supported: SteamVR (Quest & Index) - Requires Motion Controllers.
